# VAE-Based Compression of GLV Time Series

**Publication-ready implementation of Variational Autoencoders for compressing multivariate ecological time series generated by Generalized Lotka-Volterra (GLV) dynamics.**

---

## 📄 Overview

This repository contains the code and analysis for our research on using LSTM-based Variational Autoencoders to learn compact latent representations of complex ecological dynamics. The model compresses 7-species × 65-timestep multivariate time series into a 30-dimensional latent space while preserving dynamical properties.

**Key Features:**
- LSTM-VAE architecture with log-scale prediction for reconstruction
- Semantic latent space encoding ecological features (diversity, temporal variance, etc.)
- Comprehensive analysis of learned representations
- Interactive 3D latent space visualization
- Publication-quality figure generation

**Inspired by:** [LSMGD](https://github.com/yasab27/LSMGD)

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Installation

```bash
# Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/TimeSeries.git
cd TimeSeries

# Create conda environment
conda create -n timeseries python=3.12
conda activate timeseries

# Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### Generate Sample Data

```bash
# Generate small sample dataset for testing
python data_generation/generate_family_FIXED.py

# This creates:
# - data/TRAIN_FINAL_FIXED.pkl (150K samples)
# - data/TEST_FINAL_FIXED.pkl (50K samples)
```

### Train Model

```bash
# Train LSTM-VAE model
python src/training/train_cvae.py

# Model checkpoints saved to: outputs/checkpoints/
# Logs saved to: outputs/logs/
# WandB tracking: https://wandb.ai/your-project
```

### Generate Figures

```bash
# Generate all 6 main paper figures
python analysis/generate_paper_figures.py
# Output: outputs/figures/Figure1-6_*.pdf

# Generate semantic analysis figures
python analysis/semantic_analysis.py
# Output: outputs/figures/Figure7-10_*.pdf

# Generate interactive 3D visualization
python analysis/interactive_explorer.py
# Output: latent_explorer_3d.html
```

---

## 📊 Model Architecture

**LSTM-VAE (cvae.py)**
- **Encoder:** Bidirectional LSTM → 30D latent space (μ, log σ²)
- **Decoder:** LSTM with log-scale prediction → 7 × 65 reconstruction
- **Latent dim:** 30
- **Loss:** α-divergence reconstruction + β-weighted KL divergence
- **Training:** ~2000 epochs with β warmup (0 → 2e-4)

See [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) for detailed architecture description.

---

## 📈 Results

**Reconstruction Quality:**
- Mean reconstruction MSE: 0.003
- Coverage (±2σ): >95% for all species

**Latent Space Properties:**
- Semantically organized by ecological features
- Linear correlations with diversity (R²=0.75), temporal variance (R²=0.68)
- 4 distinct dynamical regimes identified via clustering

**Key Findings:**
1. Latent space encodes **dynamical phenotypes**, not interaction matrices (genotypes)
2. Diversity and temporal variance are most strongly encoded
3. Latent arithmetic enables interpolation between dynamical behaviors

See [outputs/figures/](outputs/figures/) for all paper figures.

## 🧪 Reproducing Results

### Full Pipeline

```bash
# 1. Generate data (~4-5 hours)
python data_generation/generate_family_FIXED.py

# 2. Train model (~8-12 hours on GPU)
python src/training/train_cvae.py

# 3. Generate all figures (~10 minutes)
python analysis/generate_paper_figures.py
python analysis/semantic_analysis.py
python analysis/interactive_explorer.py
```

### Using Pre-trained Model

Download pre-trained checkpoint from [releases](https://github.com/yourusername/TimeSeries/releases):

```bash
# Place checkpoint in model_ckpts/
wget https://github.com/.../model_final_30.pth -O model_ckpts/model_final_30.pth

# Generate figures directly
python analysis/generate_paper_figures.py
```
